text:
nina: Quick flag: noticed quota spikes for a few orgs after we flipped the sticky-routing tweak. Looks like some requests are being charged to both org and project while routing through the proxy.
arun: ugh. example req id?
nina: req `q-47c2` header dump: `X-Origin: org:bluecorp`, `X-Route-Resolved: project:blue-prod`, logs show meter labels `{owner:org:bluecorp}` and `{owner:project:blue-prod}` for same request.
bia: sounds similar to earlier double-counting bug. Is auth chain emitting both owner labels to quota service?
ops-ryan: current flow: authn emits token-subject, router may add origin-org, meter-lib increments on receipt and again after resolution. Legacy behaviour incremented at both layers.
arun: proposed fix: introduce `X-Quota-Owner` header set only after resolution, and change meter-lib to prefer that header and ignore earlier owner labels for billing counters. Keep the original labels as `X-Auth-Lineage` for debug-only sinks.
bia: agree. Also we should add a debug metric `quota.duplicate_attribution` when both legacy owner and `X-Quota-Owner` differ to catch straggler clients.
console-bot: note: dashboards assume owner label is billing owner. Changing labels will affect panels. Console owners need a mapping layer or toggle.
ops-ryan: rollout plan: 1) add feature flag `quota_owner_header_v1` in auth and router, default off. 2) meter-lib respects flag; when on, it reads `X-Quota-Owner`. 3) canary in staging -> small prod subset -> full rollout. 4) add Grafana panel for `quota.duplicate_attribution` and alert if >0.5% sustained for 15m.
nina: tests: send synthetic requests that force fallback, assert only `project` counter increments when flag on; assert metric increments on mismatch; ensure billing-pusher dedupe unchanged.
arun: I'll open two PRs: auth+router emit header behind flag, meter-lib prefers header. Bia can own metric emission and console changes.
bia: console UX: add a toggle column "attribution_lineage" collapsed by default. Add migration mapping so historical dashboards continue to show billing owner for 30 days.
ops-ryan: deploy-bot: started canary deploy `auth-proxy:quota-header-canary` to staging at 09:14.
nina: thanks. tagging @finance for watching invoices for any drift after rollout.
arun: will include backfill script to tag recent traces with derived `quota_owner` so debugging is easier.
bia: small note: ensure `X-Quota-Owner` uses stable canonical identifiers (org:<id> or project:<id>) not opaque tokens.
nina: agreed. I'll add sample traces and the failing query to ticket PLAT-9991. ping when PRs are ready. :thumbsup:
